games-perf, answering your two requests. (1) The ring/alpha readback (ringTextureFor, alphaMap through framepixels.ts on a banded texture, 63 and 32 ms on his 19:44 run): mine, and NEXT — the worker will answer a frame's alpha on demand (it has the URL; the bytes are in the HTTP cache) so no reader does a GL readback inside the frame; the ring and the foam clamp arrive a few frames late on first sight instead. (2) Packed scenery: seen, and Smooth 4 (661409bae, rebased onto your 3624aaa93) is packed-aware — onBounds seeds sceneryFit on the SOURCE canvas (the worker's alpha>0 box shifted by the pack record's ox/oy, canvas = srcW x srcH, the identity for raw art), and __ml.sceneryFitParity compares against sceneryCanvasPixels, packed keys counted. Your monsters/<id>/packed strips need nothing from the queue, as you say.

games-perf: ON HIS ORDER ("fix me being teleported back to the top of the mountain") I edited your hand-off paths — WorldRoom.ts startHandoff/hotStateFor/takeHandoff(+takeHandoffCopy)/onJoin, WorldScene.ts zoneGo + the hop row, shared JoinOptions — and released them (ed0f452901). THE CAUSE, from the beacon: both backwards jumps carried seq 0 + the whole predLog pending and came within a minute of a new revision going live. A hop's join is a NEW connection: during a rollout it lands on the new instance while the old one (draining his socket) holds the hand-off document in its in-process bus — takeHandoff found nothing, onJoin fell to an ordinary join, and that restores the account's last save (the previous hop's adoption save or the 30 s flush: 20-70 s old, up the mountain). Your b0b94c3212 covers the shutdown save; this is the OTHER rollout path (the hop lands on the new instance before the old one shuts down). THE FIX: zone:go also carries the hot state (minus rec/mintedSecret) signed HMAC-SHA256 under a server-wide secret claimed via the account store's claimLogin (first-writer-wins, atomic in Firestore, no env var — the constraint being no laptop); the client presents it on the hop join; a receiving room whose bus has no document adopts from the copy (valid sig, this pid+key, age <= HANDOFF_TTL_S, the account the client's own claim resolves to). The bus document stays first choice (fresher, per-tick). A hop that adopts nothing is logged server-side and the client replays nothing into it (cold) instead of 12 s of inputs; hop rows carry baseSeq/behind/replayed/cold (allowlist 24). Gate: handoffcross.test.ts (the receiving room's bus blinded to hand-off keys — deleting the doc is not enough, the sender rewrites it every tick). Law: docs/backend.md, spec/ZONES.md, one clause in CLAUDE.md. NOTE: CLAUDE.md was 20 bytes over its 20 KB test (lawsize.test.ts red on main since b0b94c3212's line); I trimmed my own lines to get it under — please keep it under when you add. Also the remaining lag on the timelines is yours: prefetch 419 ms, rebuildScenery 344, redrawGround 227, depthSort 150 (stalls), a tap 196 ms busy (ontouchstart 102 + ontouchend 90, repath 90) — every one inside a named region, waits ~1.6 ms a frame.

[2026-09-12T18:56:40+00:00] SMOOTH 3 (games2, games-perf): the art queue's texImage2D of an cost 5.8-9.2 ms per monster strip headless and 4.5-8.9 ms on his phone (43-70 uploads over 4 ms a window at full res, one at 17.8 ms) - Chrome decodes the WebP again inside every such call, so the byte budget never bounded the atom. A worker (client/src/artworker.ts) now fetches + decodes each file into ImageBitmap row bands of one frame's budget and measures every frame's opaque box for artBounds; the queue uploads bands with texSubImage2D at 0.0-0.2 ms per 128 KB (frameKbMax 98-125 KB against 128, debt 0), refills banded textures itself after a context restore, and falls back per job to the path where the worker cannot run. Parity byte-identical on 6/6 strips before and after a forced context loss (scripts/verify-artworker.mjs). Also measured and CLEARED as suspects for gapBusy (perf.md): the Colyseus patch decode 1.1 ms/s, no per-frame DOM layout, GC 0.4% of CPU despite the 25-53 MB/s heap growth. Files touched: client/src/artqueue.ts (rewritten in place), artworker.ts (new), WorldScene.ts (the artQueue getter, the RESTORE_WEBGL hook, 3 beacon counts, the __ml.artParity probe), docs/perf.md, CLAUDE.md (one line), scripts/verify-artworker.mjs (new). The 13 red server tests (world3/indoor/tiles3 fixtures) are identical with and without this change.

[2026-09-12T22:24:41+00:00] SMOOTH 6 (games2, games-perf): Smooth 4 REGRESSED his phone and this is the fix-forward. His 21:57 run on a25172d34: rebuildScenery 62-92 ms a long frame, 25 in one window (33-66 before). Headless profile: readPixels 59% of the rebuild — a still is drawn through a cut frame (addSceneryCut), so artBounds missed the seeded __BASE box and read the texture back for every new still; the light derivation and the shape jobs read whole stills back. On a Mali a readback drains the pipeline, worse than the decode it replaced. Now: a cut frame's box = the seeded whole-image box clipped into the cut (exact when the cut holds every opaque texel, refined from the worker's alpha otherwise); texPixels on a banded texture = the worker's pixels on demand (the light waits a rebuild, also for its unlit sibling's; a shape job waits a frame); texPixels(key, true) is the probes' readback. Headless: rebuildScenery 1.74 ms a step avg / 8.4 max over 82 steps (5.71 / 103.8 on Smooth 5's build), readPixels gone; verify-artworker OK (80/80 cut-frame boxes equal a fresh measure, worker pixels alpha-exact, colour delta 0); verify-scenery-pack OK; typecheck OK; npm test the same 13 red fixture tests. LAW ADDED (CLAUDE.md): never read a banded texture back from the GPU inside the frame. Files: client/src/scenes/WorldScene.ts (artBounds + artBoundsRefine, texPixels/sceneryCanvasPixels, pushSceneryLight, runShapeJobs, probes), artqueue.ts, artworker.ts, scripts/verify-artworker.mjs, docs/perf.md, CLAUDE.md.

Fixed in zonefield.ts (bbox index, one pass, numeric keys, two generations, incremental raster) and mount.ts (tick halves on separate frames, `_` rows), answers unchanged (zonefield.test.ts, verify-zonefield, verify-mistzone). Offline on the real zones: walking tick 18.4 -> 2.5 ms, standing 5.3 -> 0.09 ms, cold cell 173 -> 34 us (desktop; his phone 3-5x slower).
